trend.title: Price trend
trend.sub: How Arya works out a price move.
trend.row1Text: Arya compares the first and the latest price you paid at the store you use most for this item.
trend.row2Text: Sale prices count as what you paid. A trend needs 3 or more buys over 4 weeks or more. Moves under 2% are not shown.
trend.row3Text: This is your price, not an official inflation number.

cheaper.title: Cheaper store
cheaper.sub: How Arya picks the cheaper store.
cheaper.row1Text: The last price you paid at each store for this same item.
cheaper.row2Text: A store counts as cheaper only when it saves at least 25 cents and 5%.
cheaper.row3Text: Prices change. This is what you paid, not today's shelf price.

similar.title: Similar items
similar.row1Text: Other items you bought with the same kind of name, such as other milks.
similar.row2Text: When both names give a size, Arya shows the price per ounce so they compare fairly.
similar.row3Text: Arya never looks up prices on store sites, flyers or the web.

basket.title: Your prices
basket.sub: How Arya works out your own inflation.
basket.row1Text: Items you bought both then (60 to 120 days ago) and now (the last 30 days). Each item counts once.
basket.row2Text: Each item is weighed by how often you bought it in the last 3 months.
basket.row3Text: Your own prices at your own stores, not an official inflation number.

split.title: Split smarter
split.row1Text: Your last 6 months. An item counts when you bought it at 2 or more stores.
split.row2Text: The other store must save at least 25 cents and 5% on that item.
split.row3Text: Travel time and gas are not counted.

waste.title: Food that expired
waste.row1Text: Items you marked "It expired" this month.
waste.row2Text: Each item at the price you last paid. An item with no price counts as $0.

welcome.title: Hi, I'm Arya
welcome.line: Your grocery helper. I keep your lists, tell you what's running low, and help you shop faster.
welcome.remindersSub: Use it before it goes off

today.title: Today
today.line: What needs you today: running low, use soon, and tips.

lists.title: Lists
lists.line: Make one list per store. Add items by typing, talking, or snapping a photo of a paper list.

ask.title: Ask
ask.line: Ask Arya anything about your groceries: what to cook, what you spent, or where to buy it.

quest.title: Quest (optional)
quest.line: Turn a store trip into a treasure hunt: Arya walks you aisle by aisle. Try it once you have a list.

settings.title: Settings

guide.tryLine: Try it here. Nothing is saved.

what.title: Groceries, sorted.
what.body: Arya keeps a list for each store, reminds you what to use before it goes off, and learns your prices from your receipts. Shopping gets quicker every week.

lists.title: One list for each store
lists.p1: Type, talk, or snap a photo of a paper list.
lists.p2: Arya puts each item on the store you usually buy it at.
lists.p3: Tap Start shopping and Arya walks you through the store, item by item.
lists.try: Try it with a sample list ▸

usesoon.title: Snap a date, skip the waste
usesoon.body: Point your camera at the date on a pack. Arya reads it and reminds you before the food goes off. No typing.
usesoon.try: Try it with a sample yogurt ▸

receipts.title: See where your money goes
receipts.body: Snap a receipt or add a PDF. Arya files it, checks the total, and shows your spending by month and by store.
receipts.try: Try it with a sample receipt ▸

prices.title: Know where it's cheaper
prices.body: From your own receipts, Arya shows which of your stores is cheaper for an item and which prices are creeping up. It turns on after receipts from 2 stores.

ask.title: Ask about your groceries
ask.body: What to cook, what you spent, where something is cheaper. Arya answers from your own lists and receipts.

quest.title: Make a trip a treasure hunt
quest.body: Quest turns a store trip into a game: Arya walks you aisle by aisle and you collect each item as you find it. It's optional; your lists work the same without it.

receipt.title: Add a receipt
receipt.s1: Settings › Receipts, or the camera on a list.
receipt.s2: Snap the receipt or pick a PDF.
receipt.s3: Arya files it and checks the total.

shop.title: Start shopping
shop.s1: Open Lists and tap a store's list.
shop.s3: Pick Quest. Arya walks you through the store, item by item.
shop.s4: At the end, add your receipt.

share.title: Share a list with your household
share.s1: Settings › Start a group, and give it a name.
share.s2: Your lists become the group's lists.
share.s3: Tap Invite someone and send them the code.

expiry.title: Snap an expiry date
expiry.s1: On Today, under Use soon, tap Snap a date.
expiry.s2: Tap Take a photo of the date on the pack.
expiry.s3: Check the item and the date, then tap Looks right, track it.
expiry.s4: Arya reminds you before it goes off.

ask.title: Ask Arya a question
ask.s2: Type or say your question, or tap a suggestion.
ask.s3: Arya answers from your own lists and receipts.

usesoon.title: Snap a date
usesoon.line: Point the camera at the date on the pack.
usesoon.photoAria: A sample yogurt pot with its date
usesoon.after: Arya reminds you before it goes off. You can mark it used or expired on Today.
